data.title: Butterfly Picnic!
data.description: Practice giving a requested number of objects from a larger collection by adding more butterflies to the board.

challenges.instruction: Put two more butterflies on the board. How many altogether?
challenges.hint: Try touching each butterfly one by one as you count them all together.
challenges.narration: Look at these butterflies! Let's put some more on the board and count the total amount together.

challenges.instruction: Put two more butterflies on the board. How many altogether?
challenges.hint: Count the first ones, then keep counting the new ones we added!
challenges.narration: Wonderful! We added a few more butterflies. Can you find out how many there are altogether?

challenges.instruction: Put one more butterflies on the board. How many altogether?
challenges.hint: Touch every single butterfly to make sure you get the total count right.
challenges.narration: The garden is getting busier! Let's count every butterfly on the board.

challenges.instruction: Put one more butterflies on the board. How many altogether?
challenges.hint: Go around in a circle and tap each butterfly to count them all.
challenges.narration: Look at them fly in! Can you count every single butterfly on the board now?

challenges.instruction: Put three more butterflies on the board. How many altogether?
challenges.hint: Take your time and touch each butterfly slowly so none get missed.
challenges.narration: This is our biggest butterfly group yet! Count them carefully from start to finish.
